sources.detail: Attempted and Cloudflare-blocked from this runner for the 10th consecutive day. One bounded direct GET per registered page with the full browser header set (UA + Accept + Accept-Language + sec-ch-ua + Sec-Fetch-* + Upgrade-Insecure-Requests + no-cache): HTTP 403 with the "Attention Required! | Cloudflare" interstitial on all six URLs (1,892-1,894 B bodies). This agrees exactly with the independent pre-agent published-evidence receipt (http 403, dateModified null, lastUpdated null, resolved null, all six pages). No proxy, no challenge solve, no replay, no r.jina.ai. Nothing parsed, so nothing written: the snapshot stays 2026-09-27 (set by the 09-27 residential local run), every page-stated published date is untouched and no seasonVerified value changed. The stored 80 Icy Veins letters stand and keep feeding both brackets' consensus (owner-confirmed retention: an outage does not remove a source).

Both registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET: HTTP 200, 170,984 B (raiding) and 177,635 B (mythic-plus) decoded. Era-verified from the ranking BODY, not the metadata: the og:description on both still carries the stale "The War Within Season 3" boilerplate while the body reads "Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss" and "Mythic+ content and dungeon difficulty in Midnight Season 2" (Tactyks' byline), so seasonVerified stays "s2" on both. Parsed from the tier__tier / tier__title / tier__icon blocks with the spec read off data-original-title and looked up WHOLE against the roster: 3 tierlist containers on raid and 5 on M+, 40 roster rows each (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank, Devourer present in both), 8 distinct non-roster labels correctly rejected by ROSTER MATCH rather than position (King's Rest, Ruby Life Pools, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale, Den of Nalorakk, Murder Row, Temple of Sethraliss, Altar of Fangs). All 80 letters are identical to stored, so 0 moves. The pages' own Last Updated lines re-read unchanged (raid 10th August 2026, M+ 13th August 2026) and agree with the pre-agent published-evidence receipt; published stays 2026-08-10 / 2026-08-13 and only snapshot advances to 2026-10-02. Noting for the heartbeat: at 53 days the raid page self-date now exceeds this requirement's 45-day published window, so check-refresh --age reports a published-lag line for Method. That is the lag signal working on a genuinely quiet publisher (the capture is today's and the letters were re-verified), not a dishonest claim, and no date was moved to suppress it.

All six registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 76,505-346,700 B decoded (no r.jina.ai - dead on /guide/* since 2026-08-03). Unescaped \/ to / across the whole document FIRST, then matched [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] and tier labels with tolerant whitespace, taking the block with the most roster spec-badges rather than anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml( (the raid-healer decoy). Per-page row counts printed and reconciled: 27 / 7 / 6 on raid and 27 / 7 / 6 on M+ = 80, every spec-badge slug resolving to a roster spec with 0 rejects and 0 role mismatches, A+ present on the M+ DPS scale. All 80 letters identical to stored, 0 moves. Each page's own JSON-LD dateModified re-read and byte-equal to the independent pre-agent receipt: raid 2026-08-31 x3, M+ DPS 2026-08-28, M+ healer 2026-09-10, M+ tank 2026-09-01 - so published is unchanged and only snapshot advances to 2026-10-02. The three "12.1.5" hits on every page are the env-switcher links to the separate wowhead.com/ptr-2/ preview pages, not a 12.1.5 ranking on the registered live page, so seasonVerified stays "s2" (a mid-season patch does not move the season).

Fetched successfully, but the payload is byte-identical to stored, so the coverage date cannot advance and this is not a success. Two plain curl calls to the JSON API (no headers, no proxy, no auth, never the HTML prerender): manifest.json HTTP 200, 353 B, snapshotDate 2026-09-15 and Last-Modified 15 Sep 2026 - unmoved for an EIGHTH consecutive week - and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200, 162,488 B, Last-Modified 29 Sep 2026. Because a newer Last-Modified with a frozen manifest is the documented 2026-08-04 shape, the rankings file was fetched and DIFFED rather than trusted to the manifest: 44 blocks, whitelisting categoryType in {dps, hps, tank} AND sortField === "lowerBound" AND keyRange === undefined gives 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched (the melee/ranged blocks are dps subsets and were excluded by whitelist, not by blacklisting "dungeon"). Compared at the stored 1-dp precision, all 40 lowerBound values and all 40 n are identical to stored. Nothing merged, asOf unchanged at 2026-09-15; the age red is the honest signal and the owner-accepted standing state.

The trusted pre-agent fetch-stable-metrics.mjs step reports Murlok INVALID this run, so nothing was merged and no second parser was written. Receipt (metrics-fetch/evidence.json, checkedAt 2026-10-02T16:23:25.603Z): all three meta pages HTTP 200 on the first attempt (71,302 / 42,299 / 40,903 B), but every page's own <time datetime> now reads 2026-09-29T02:10:2xZ, i.e. OLDER than the 2026-10-01 date the same DPS page published yesterday, so the collector refused the merge with "Source date regressed for Warrior|Arms (2026-09-29 < 2026-10-01)" and reported rows 0. A source-owned date moving backwards is a source/parser-identity question for review, not an outage and not something to paper over by substituting the fetch date, so this is parse_error rather than partial. Stored data is left exactly as it was: 40 rows, dates spanning 2026-09-29..2026-10-01, and the murlok registry pages untouched (the receipt checker requires a failed source to leave both the canonical rows and its registry entry unchanged). node src/check-stable-metrics.mjs passes on that basis. A later period that re-advances the page date clears this by itself.

Fetched fresh and complete, but upstream has not re-simmed since September 30, so the coverage date is two days old and this is not a success. All 27 DPS specs requested from chart/get/talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk/<snake_class>/<spec>: 23 returned real payloads and 4 returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on 2 attempts each (Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker, Subtlety Rogue - the same persistent set as last night). Every one of the 23 reads simc_settings.tier = "MID2" and simc_settings.ptr = the STRING "0" (compared explicitly, never truthiness), and the target map was read as data[tier][count], which is already best-build. Per-chart timestamps are all 2026-09-30, taken per spec from the payload and never stamped with the run date. The 12.1.5 wholesale-hold rule does NOT engage: PHASES.livePatch is null, LABEL_FLIP_DUE is null, and this run's own evidence puts 12.1.5 at October 13 (not live), so neither keying date applies and the normal merge stands. Merged all 23 at their own chart dates: every value byte-identical to stored, 0 moves. Subtlety Rogue keeps its stored 2026-09-23 MID2 profile rather than being dropped, so the pool stays 24 profiles, single-tier MID2, satisfying the uniformity gate; row floor 15 and the 25% row-drop gate both clear.

Fetched fresh and the sim DID re-run on a new git build, so the source-owned coverage date advances. reports/MID2_Raid.txt HTTP 200, 1,446,737 B, and it HAD a "DPS Ranking:" block, so the MID2_Raid.html fallback and its burst/DTPS-chart inflation trap were not needed. Era-verified off the HEADER build string, never a visible version number: "SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69933 Live (hotfix 2026-10-01/69933, git build HEAD 38e22bd21a, no-networking)" - live 12.1.0, no 12.1.5 anywhere. The git HEAD moved 7cbb6ef5ff -> 38e22bd21a while the build number held at 69933; that SHA is the documented freshness detector and the honest explanation for the movement. 55 ranking lines, the Raid aggregate row skipped, mapped by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed to 24 DPS specs at their best hero variant and 0 unmapped profile names beyond the 14 tank rows, which are correctly not ingested (Blood DK, Vengeance, Brewmaster, both Protections); the 3 DPS specs absent upstream are Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker and Devastation Evoker. All 24 values moved and every move is noise - largest Havoc Demon Hunter 271,366 -> 271,068 = -0.11%, far under maxValueMovePct 0.6 - so nothing was held back and no value_move_ack is needed. asOf = the report's own hotfix date 2026-10-01.

Verified this run by the trusted pre-agent fetch-stable-metrics.mjs step and merged ONLY through node src/apply-metrics.mjs metrics-fetch/updates.json - no agent-side parse. Receipt (checkedAt 2026-10-02T16:23:25.603Z): status success, /period/latest redirecting to /period/1083 (HTTP 200, 218,803 B) - the SAME weekly period as last night, so this is a same-day-style recheck of unchanged data rather than a new period. 39 rows, and the share-column sanity checks reconcile: sum 99.9, role totals Ranged 29.6 / Melee 30.4 / Tank 20 / Healer 19.9 against the page's printed 29.7 / 30.3 / 20 / 20, i.e. the representation SHARE column and not the /meta per-key-presence figure. Mage|Fire is omitted upstream and retiredSpecs is empty - correctly, because Fire Mage has no stored Mythicstats row to retire. All 39 values are byte-identical to stored and the merge moved nothing, so every asOf keeps its own existing date (37 at 2026-10-01, one 2026-09-29, one 2026-09-27) exactly as the undated-source rule requires: no row was re-dated to today. Coverage date is therefore 2026-10-01, one day old. node src/check-stable-metrics.mjs passes.

All four official channels swept, and the one new thing landed in the feed. (1) Official revision ledger, run FIRST: the pre-agent fetch-official-notes.mjs receipts (checkedAt 2026-10-02T16:23:30.335Z) show live-hotfixes topic 2336376 post 1 moving version 51 -> 53 (updatedAt 2026-10-02T00:02:37.783Z) with TWO new class sections, and ptr-preview topic 2344395 posts 1 (v3), 4 (v1), 5 (v1), 6 (v1) all at unchanged body hashes with 0 added/edited/removed sections. Both new sections are dated 2026-10-01 and are now dispositioned "applied" with build references: Druid|Feral (Rampant Ferocity single-target trigger fix) and Hunter|Survival (Wildfire Bomb periodic damage +20%). Section inventory 163 -> 165, the 27 live-hotfix removed-section tombstones carried forward, 0 unresolved, and the only other field that changed is each source's check time. node src/check-official-notes.mjs --base=HEAD passes. (2) Live 12.1 lane: the October 1 hotfix block is logged as a NEW feed entry, kind "hotfix" realm "live", 43 -> 44 entries. Read from the configured canonical source (topic 2336376 post 1 at v53, re-fetched from the topic JSON this run with its heading nesting INTACT - Feral and Survival each sit under their own spec heading, so neither is attributed by guess) and cross-checked line for line against the Wowhead mirror news=383227 (2026-10-02T00:04:45Z); the two agree exactly. specsAffected Feral Druid + Survival Hunter, three highlights including one non-class Ula'tek Venomous Heart fix. classifyHighlight: the Survival line votes buff, the Feral bug fix and the non-class line abstain; both specs' outlooks are driven by their dated ptr.verdict (Mixed) and neither DIRECTION moved - only the basis line counts (Survival +5/-1 -> +6/-1 across 8 -> 9 builds). Blizzard's developers' note says this +20% is the part of the week-of-September-22 pass that did not apply, so the label records it as that pass landing rather than a second buff, and Wowhead's 0% ST / 6.2% AoE estimates are not stored as official values. NO SET BONUS IS TOUCHED (zero hits for "set bonus", "-piece", "tier set" in the October 1 block), so no spec.tierSet date advances and no gearing mirror resync was due. No Player versus Player heading this time, so rule 3c did not apply. (3) Discovery, three transports: Wowhead RSS (40 items, 201,077 B, parsed per <item> block), the news INDEX payload data.news.newsData (20 posts, brace-balanced off the id attribute; top item 383226 at 2026-10-02 09:15 agrees with the RSS top, so nothing landed mid-run) and the blue-tracker payload data.blueTracker.default (50 entries). Nothing else for live 12.1. (4) NOT logged, deliberately, and recorded here instead: the consolidated 12.1.5 Content Update Notes (topic 2368213 US / 632922 EU, Wowhead news=383206, published 2026-10-01T12:00Z) and the "Arrives October 13" announcement (topics 2366152 / 2366151, blue-tracker 24307306, news from 2026-09-29) - 12.1.5 is not live, so consolidated notes cannot enter data/ptr-builds.json as patch-notes or as a PTR build while PHASES.ptr is null; the 12.1.5 PTR development-notes thread reaches the site only through the notes-only preview lane, which reported no change this run. Also seen and not logged: Wowhead's separate Survival article news=383216 (the same hotfix, cited in the entry label), and the many "WoW: Forever" beta articles, which are a different product. OWNER ACTION STILL OPEN, third run running: LABEL_FLIP_DUE in src/normalize.mjs is still null while the October 13 release date is now confirmed by Blizzard's own notes - the label-flip heartbeat stays inert until an owner sets it. Dormant WCL PTR zone sweeps (52/54/56/57) skipped as specified; their stored receipts were not read or touched.

Every configured YouTube feed polled inline in the foreground: 44 distinct channel ids behind the 79 transcribable creator entries (76 class-scoped + 3 generalCreators), up to 3 attempts each, 44 of 44 HTTP 200, 0 failures, 0 entries missing a channelId; the 40 transcribable:false entries were skipped by design. No yt-dlp and no transcript API call was made by this agent - it holds no transcript credentials. Seen-set rebuilt from structured data only (pending-transcripts seen[] 551 + skipped[] 448 + videos[] + every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url) = 1,316 ids; never regexed from log prose. 402 unseen videos are in-cycle against the computed bound (the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, 2026-06-18, taken as a date and not an index), 184 of them keyword-matching; this is a NIGHTLY run, so the keyword filter stays and the queue stays narrow. TRANSCRIPTS: the deterministic step pre-fetched 1 of the 2 queued videos (summary verdict "review-required", usage 36 counted requests in the 30-day window, limit null). izen's LKzPqYFo6dw (2026-09-30, 481 chunks, 3,447 words) was read in full and distilled into 7 M+-lens metaNotes in the generalCreator lane - Unholy DK positive, Arms Warrior negative, Blood DK negative (he says explicitly it is displacement, not a nerf), Guardian Druid positive (with no buff behind it), Assassination Rogue positive, Elemental Shaman mixed, Arcane Mage neutral (a read he genuinely expresses, not a filler) - each superseding that creator's previous live M+ note for the same spec, 7 superseded. Every number was checked back against the chunk it is deep-linked to, and ASR mangles ("Anoli"/"ank" for Unholy, "Mwever" for Mistweaver) are paraphrased, never quoted. DECLINED on the documented rules: Protection Paladin, Protection Warrior and Brewmaster (a single +21 damage-taken log and a bare "tanks gave up on them" enumeration - fight artifact plus list-mention), Frost DK ("stays practically the same", a representation observation inside an enumeration) and Feral/Outlaw/Windwalker (named only in a list of niche melee comps). Its id was removed from videos[] in the same edit, as the one-record rule requires. QsYJEKOp-dA (Tactyks) stays queued: the provider returned request-timeout and the step recorded "review-required" with no automatic retry, so its state was left exactly as written and no replacement fetch was attempted. QUEUED two new in-scope videos, both verified against this run's live feed with an author match: Obli's cUeoz6js3OY "How has the state of DK been in Season 2 of Midnight?" (2026-10-02, a season-state DK round-up with two DK guests - guest attribution rules will apply at distillation) and Musguete's zQgeZR1ag0Q "Patch 12.1.5 Rogue Changes" (2026-10-01, which would be framed "12.1.5 PTR preview - NOT LIVE"). Queue 2 -> 3. Nothing else was queued and nothing was marked seen on a budget or title judgment, so the remaining 400 unseen in-cycle videos stay genuinely unexamined and reconsiderable.
